stance_basis: opens letter stating he 'heartily endorse[s]' the Bad Creek Pumped-Storage Project
summary: Mayor Robert E. Gaillard of Walhalla, South Carolina, wrote to the Federal Power Commission in November 1975 to express his strong support for Duke Power Company's Bad Creek Pumped-Storage Project. He characterized the project as a 'definite asset' to his county and emphasized its importance for meeting regional energy needs. He requested that his endorsement be entered into the official record.
complaint_summary: Mayor Gaillard writes to heartily endorse the Bad Creek Pumped-Storage Project, calling it a definite asset to his county and important for regional energy needs, and requests the endorsement be entered into the official record.

statement.text:
I wish to take this opportunity to notify the Federal Power Commission that I heartily endorse Duke Power Company's Bad Creek Pumped-Storage Project in South Carolina. I feel that this will be a definite asset to our county and that it will substantially aide in the energy needs for this region in the coming years. I respectfully request that you make this a matter of your records.
Sincerely yours,
Robert d. Halland
Robett E. Gaillard Mayor
